About me

Design experience you can trust, with the care of a personal partner.

For more than 16 years I have helped startups, SMEs, agencies and established companies turn ideas into brands people remember. I have worked across agencies, in-house teams and my own independent studio, which means I understand both creative excellence and business realities.

When you work with me, you work directly with a senior designer. No juniors, no hand-offs, no hidden layers. Just clear communication, strategic thinking and work delivered on time.

  • Strategy-led, not trend-led design
  • One partner for brand, web, print & digital
  • Experience with local & global markets
  • Transparent pricing & dependable deadlines

How it works

A simple, proven design process

Clear steps, clear timelines and no surprises, whether your project takes a week or six months.

  1. 01

    Discover

    A free consultation to understand your business, audience, competitors and goals. You get a clear scope and fixed quote.

  2. 02

    Strategy

    Research, positioning and creative direction that make every design decision purposeful, not random.

  3. 03

    Design

    Concepts, refinement and feedback rounds in Figma or Adobe, with full transparency at every milestone.

  4. 04

    Deliver & Support

    Final files, guidelines, launch support and ongoing help as your brand and business grow.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?

Yes. I work with clients across Pakistan and internationally, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the UK, the USA, Canada and Australia. Communication happens over email, WhatsApp, Slack and video calls, and invoices can be in PKR or USD.

How do your prices work?

Every project gets a fixed, itemised quote after a free discovery call, so there are no hourly surprises. Larger projects are split into milestones, typically 50% upfront and 50% on completion.

How many revisions are included?

Most projects include two to three structured revision rounds. The exact number is stated in your proposal before we start.

Will I own the final designs?

Yes. Once the project is paid in full, you receive full ownership and all editable source files.

How quickly can you start?

Usually within one to two weeks, depending on the current schedule. Urgent projects can sometimes be accommodated, so just ask.
